rationale: The bearish micro-structure that justified the short is still intact — price at $229.48 remains below session VWAP ($231.28) and the 5m 9-EMA ($229.97), relative volume is still elevated at 2.39x, and the risk-off backdrop (SPY -0.87%, VIXY +2.38%) persists. The recent grind higher is only ~0.7 of a 5m ATR and stays well inside the $230.20 invalidation, while price sits in the lower 21% of today's range near session lows, so the thesis has not been disproven. A flip long lacks structural support given price is still under both VWAP and the 9-EMA, and the small -0.30% drawdown does not warrant closing a position whose levels remain unviolated.
